title: Local music score
description: Render an editable music2 Song JSON into a synthesized WAV. Built-in instruments, up to 60 seconds.
author: Viral Hit contributors

parameters.label: Song JSON
parameters.default:
{
  "version": 1,
  "title": "Viral Hit — first pulse",
  "bpm": 120,
  "seed": 7301,
  "sampleRate": 48000,
  "loop": true,
  "tailSeconds": 1,
  "master": { "ceilingDb": -1, "targetLufs": -18 },
  "tracks": [
    { "id": "kick", "kind": "drums", "instrument": "drums", "pattern": "bd ~ bd ~", "gain": -20 },
    { "id": "hats", "kind": "drums", "instrument": "drums", "pattern": "~ hh ~ hh", "gain": -27 },
    { "id": "keys", "kind": "notes", "instrument": "marimba", "pattern": "c4 e4 g4 b4", "gain": -18, "sends": { "reverb": 0.1 } }
  ],
  "sections": [{ "id": "pulse", "bars": 2 }],
  "arrangement": [{ "section": "pulse" }]
}
